2608.28053.title: CNeo-Bench: Diagnosing Large Language Models on Chinese Neologisms
2608.28053.paper_summary: Chinese neologisms exploit diverse and unique linguistic mechanisms, such as phonetic substitution (e.g., 886 for ``bye-bye'') and visual character decomposition that are rare in other languages. We introduce CNeo-Bench, a benchmark of 4,759 such neologisms with reference definitions, organized into five top-level categories and nine subcategories by the linguistic mechanism behind each expression. CNeo-Bench is paired with a two-tier evaluation framework that separates whether a model can describe a neologism from whether it can operate on its underlying mechanism. Evaluating 18 LLMs, we find that Chinese neologisms remain an open challenge; most models fall below 40\% on definition generation, and on several subcategories a systematic recognition-manipulation gap emerges: models describe neologisms correctly but, in source-form restoration tasks, substitute a semantic equivalent (paraphrase) for the source form rather than producing the source form itself. A few-shot analysis on 1,058 hard items shows that in-context examples can solve many difficult cases, but leave a noticeable portion of errors remaining, indicating challenges beyond prompting alone can address.
2608.28053.paper_summary_zh: 中國的新詞彙利用多樣且獨特的語言機制，例如音韻替代（例如，886代表「再見」）和視覺字符分解，這在其他語言中較為罕見。<lb/>我們介紹CNeo-Bench，一個包含4,759個此類新詞彙的基準，並附有參考定義，根據每個表達背後的語言機制，組織成五個頂層類別和九個子類別。<lb/>CNeo-Bench配備了一個兩層的評估框架，將模型能否描述新詞彙與其是否能夠運作於其基礎機制分開評估。<lb/>在對18個大型語言模型的評估中，我們發現中國的新詞彙仍然是一個開放的挑戰；大多數模型在定義生成上低於40\%，而在幾個子類別中出現了系統性的識別-操作差距：模型能正確描述新詞彙，但在源形式恢復任務中，卻用語義等價物（意譯）替代源形式，而不是生成源形式本身。<lb/>對1,058個難題的少量示例分析顯示，在上下文示例中可以解決許多困難的案例，但仍然留有明顯的錯誤部分，顯示出挑戰超出了僅僅提示所能解決的範疇。
